diagnostics.message: resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default declares an explicit depends_on on resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin, but this ordering is already established implicitly: the distribution's origin.domain_name is set from local.bucket_domain_name, which derives from local.bucket, and local.bucket references aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id. Terraform follows references through locals when building the dependency graph, so the explicit depends_on duplicates an already-inferred dependency and can be removed.
